# Skier — privacy policy

Public hosting for the privacy policy of **Skier**, so the App Store and Google
Play listings have a URL they can reach. The game itself lives in a private
repository.

**Every file here is generated. Do not edit them.** The policy is written in
`docs/privacy-policy.md` (and `.sl.md`) in the game repository and published
from there with:

    python3 tools/make_privacy_page.py --publish /path/to/skier-privacy

Editing a page here would put the published policy out of step with the one the
game shows offline, which for a legal document is the failure worth designing
against.

- English: <https://mitjafortuna.github.io/skier-privacy/privacy.html>
- Slovenian: <https://mitjafortuna.github.io/skier-privacy/privacy.sl.html>
